author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello, Before this starts I just want to say this is a complaining thread.

Lately on avicus I have noticed something about retired staff members. I feel that when they retire rules don't apply to them and they can do what ever they want because everyone knows them and likes them as a staff. I find it quite obvious who these people are. This is not towards every retired person but I think they just turn into an immature 3 year old brat.


So.... Is it just me?
